stem: Which sentence supports the idea that presidents feel comfortable aboard Air Force One?

options.label: F
options.text: Air Force One has the ability to refuel in flight, so it can fly as long as it needs to.

options.label: G
options.text: His view is that presidents seem more relaxed and act less formal aboard Air Force One than in the Oval Office.

options.label: H
options.text: This was perhaps the most famous version of Air Force One, and it carried eight presidents over the years.

options.label: J
options.text: Presidents have always had to travel, of course.
